func verifyControlStreamConfig(actual jetstream.StreamConfig, replicas int) error {
	if (replicas != 1 && replicas != 3 && replicas != 5) || actual.Name != ControlStreamName ||
		actual.Replicas != replicas || actual.Retention != jetstream.LimitsPolicy ||
		actual.Storage != jetstream.FileStorage || actual.MaxConsumers != -1 ||
		actual.MaxMsgs != -1 || actual.MaxBytes != -1 ||
		actual.MaxMsgsPerSubject != -1 || actual.MaxAge != 0 || actual.Discard != jetstream.DiscardOld ||
		actual.MaxMsgSize > 0 || actual.DiscardNewPerSubject || actual.AllowRollup ||
		actual.AllowDirect || actual.MirrorDirect || actual.NoAck || actual.Sealed ||
		!actual.DenyDelete || !actual.DenyPurge || len(actual.Subjects) != 1 ||
		actual.Subjects[0] != controlStreamSubject || actual.Mirror != nil || len(actual.Sources) != 0 ||
		actual.SubjectTransform != nil || actual.RePublish != nil || actual.AllowMsgTTL ||
		actual.SubjectDeleteMarkerTTL != 0 || actual.AllowMsgSchedules ||
		actual.Metadata["terrascale-contract"] != "authority-log-v1" {
		return errors.New("existing control log has incompatible consistency, durability, or subject configuration")
	}
	return nil
}

func observedRollup(t *testing.T, in Inputs) Rollup {
	t.Helper()
	cell := normalize(in.Cell)
	remote, conn := followedTestView(t, cell, nil, func() time.Time { return in.Now })
	changed := remote.Changed()
	local := NewView(cell, nil, func() time.Time { return in.Now })
	publishOnce(t.Context(), conn, cell, func(context.Context) Rollup { return Build(in) }, local)
	waitClosed(t, changed)
	region := readTestRegion(t, remote, cell)
	if region.Rollup == nil {
		t.Fatal("published rollup missing from regional API")
	}
	return *region.Rollup
}

internal/globalview/build.go::Build.text:
func Build(in Inputs) Rollup {
	var truncated bool
	rollup := Rollup{Version: Version, Cell: strings.ToLower(in.Cell), ObservedAt: in.Now}
	var routes []Route
	if in.ClusterOK {
		rollup.Controllers = buildControllers(in.Cluster)
		rollup.Versions = buildVersions(in.Cluster.Members)
		routes = buildRoutes(in.Cluster.Members)
	}
	nodes := buildNodes(in, &truncated)
	rollup.Totals = buildTotals(nodes)
	wan := wanSources(in.Reports)
	rollup.Replication = buildReplication(wan)
	links := buildLinks(in.Links, wan)
	rollup.Health = buildHealth(in, rollup.Controllers, nodes, links, routes)

	rollup.Nodes = keep(nodes, maxNodes, &truncated)
	rollup.Volumes = buildVolumes(in.Volumes, &truncated)
	rollup.VolumesUnavailable = in.VolumesUnavailable
	rollup.Services = boundedManagedServices(in.Services, &truncated)
	rollup.ServicesObservedAt = in.ServicesObservedAt
	rollup.Functions = keep(in.Functions, 64, &truncated)
	rollup.FunctionsObservedAt = in.FunctionsObservedAt
	rollup.Links = keep(links, maxLinks, &truncated)
	rollup.Routes = keep(routes, maxRoutes, &truncated)
	rollup.Autoscale = Autoscale{Services: buildScaling(in.Autoscale)}
	rollup.Cost = in.Cost
	rollup.Scale = in.Scale
	rollup.Databases = buildDatabases(in.Databases, &truncated)
	rollup.Errors = buildErrors(in, &truncated)
	rollup.Truncated = truncated
	return rollup
}

internal/globalview/drilldown.go::Region.text:
func (region Region) ResourceState(found bool) string {
	switch {
	case region.Rollup == nil:
		return "missing"
	case region.Stale:
		return "stale"
	case !found && region.Rollup.Truncated:
		return "truncated"
	case !found:
		return "not_found"
	default:
		return "current"
	}
}

func writeResource(writer http.ResponseWriter, result ResourceView, status int) {
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	writer.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	writer.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	writer.WriteHeader(status)
	writeJSON(writer, result)
}
